newsitem.title: USA: TRO Learning expands credit facility.
newsitem.headline: TRO Learning expands credit facility.

text.p: TRO Learning Inc said Thursday its existing credit facility was expanded to $21.0 million from $12.5 million.
The amended credit agreement with Sanwa Business Credit Corp provides for a maximum $18.0 million line of credit with substantially the same terms as the Company's current credit agreement.
In addition, the amended agreement provides for a $3.0 million term loan, subject to the company raising an additional $3.0 million of capital by June 30, 1997.
The company said it is currently pursuing alternatives to provide additional permanent capital, including a private placement of subordinated convertible debentures.

"This expanded credit facility will address the short term cyclical working capital needs of the company, as well as provide some permanent capital to support the growth of the company," Sharon Fierro, chief financial officer, said in a statement.
TRO Learning develops and markets microcomputer-based interactive, self-paced instructional and testing systems used in a wide variety of adult settings.
